label: 2. Having your own theme song would be great.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Having your own theme song would be great.
You think so?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Sure! How cool would it be if the AZX had its own theme song?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: It could play every time

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: the train departs or arrives.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Brid, Soline, what do you think?

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Sorry, just saw your message.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I think it's a good idea.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Me too!
Have you put any thought into the lyrics?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I think it could go something like this:

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Di Di Du Du~ All aboard the AZX, we're here for you!

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: It's a little short, but what do you think?
Great.
I think it's perfect as is.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Thanks, Commander!

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I think it's wonderful.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: We're here for you... I love it!

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: I'm surprised you didn't include any lyrics about strawberry candy.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I wanted to, but couldn't find anywhere to fit it in.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Anyway, that settles the lyrics.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Who should be the singer?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Have you got anyone in mind?

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: What about the Commander?

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: I bet they're a great singer.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Sounds good to me!

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: What do you say, Commander?
I am so there, girlfriend.
Music is my life.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Lol.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I like the confidence!

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Though the Commander might be a good singer,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I was hoping we could find a soprano.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Hmm, then what about Soline?

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Me? No way, I hate singing!

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: If you're thinking of asking me next,

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: the answer is no.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: All right then, so be it.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Guess it's time to throw my own hat in the ring.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: I've actually got a decent set of pipes on me.
No one replies.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Hello?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Guys? :'(

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: Sorry, I'm so late with my replies, I'm working right now.

lines.speaker: brid
lines.text: I'll talk to you later.

lines.speaker: soline
lines.text: Um... I've gotta finish cleaning the AZX. Bye.
I... also have something I need to do.

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Huh? How come everyone's so busy all of a sudden?

lines.speaker: diesel
lines.text: Fine... we'll go over it later.
